name: AQUAWALK
recent: Aquawalk Group Berhad 近期有多项董事及大股东持股变动公告，执行主席 Dato' Foong Choong Heng 与执行董事 Foong Chuen Hoe 在公开市场持续增持公司股份。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收与净利均较上一季度小幅下滑。
notable: 执行主席 Dato' Foong Choong Heng 于2026年9月至10月期间多次在公开市场增持公司股份。
执行董事兼集团首席执行官 Foong Chuen Hoe 于2026年10月20日增持500,000股。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 MYR 23,900,000，较上一季度下降5.5%；净利为 MYR 5,621,000，较上一季度下降5.9%；净利率为23.5%，上一季度为23.6%。

recent_en: Aquawalk Group Berhad has seen multiple announcements of changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, with Executive Chairman Dato' Foong Choong Heng and Executive Director Foong Chuen Hoe continuing to acquire shares in the open market. The latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) saw both revenue and net profit decline slightly quarter-on-quarter.
notable_en: Executive Chairman Dato' Foong Choong Heng acquired shares in the open market multiple times between September and October 2026.
Executive Director and Group CEO Foong Chuen Hoe acquired 500,000 shares on 20 October 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 23,900,000, down 5.5% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 5,621,000, down 5.9% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 23.5% versus 23.6% in the previous quarter.
